{{otheruses|Nine Stars of Divination|Nine Stars in Indian Astronomy|Nine Luminaries}} {{Cite source|date=December 2018}} {{color}} '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[folk belief]] originating from ancient [[China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.
The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."
== Origin == The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|magic square|ja|魔方陣}}:
{| class="wikitable" |- |Four||Nine||Two |- |Three||Five||Seven |- |Eight||One||Six |}
In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}} ({{ill|wood|ja|木}}, {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|earth|ja|土}}, {{ill|metal|ja|金}}, and {{ill|water|ja|水}}), the {{ill|ten heavenly stems|ja|十干}}, the {{ill|twelve earthly branches|ja|十二支}}, and the {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}} of {{ill|I Ching|ja|易経}}. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."
According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|ja|禹}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Luo Writing|ja|洛書}}), one of the {{ill|River Chart and Luo Writing|ja|河図洛書}}.
== The Nine Stars == In Japanese {{ill|Onmyōdō|ja|陰陽道}}, the following table associates the Nine Stars with the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}}, {{ill|directions|ja|方位}}, {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}}, and colors, forming the '''Nine Stars Chart''' used to predict {{ill|fortune|ja|運勢}} and the {{ill|auspiciousness|ja|吉凶}} of directions based on a person's birth year.
{| class="wikitable" |- ! Star ! Reading ! Five Element ! Direction ! Eight Trigram ! Color |- ! {{ill|First White Water Star|ja|一白水星}} | Ippaku Suisei | Water | {{ill|North|ja|北}} | {{ill|Kan|ja|坎}} | style="background:white;"| White |- ! {{ill|Second Black Earth Star|ja|二黒土星}} | Jikoku Dosei | Earth | Southwest | {{ill|Kun|ja|坤}} | style="background:black;color:white;"| Black |- ! {{ill|Third Blue Wood Star|ja|三碧木星}} | Sanpeki Mokusei | Wood | {{ill|East|ja|東}} | {{ill|Zhen|ja|震}} | style="background:blue;color:white;"| Blue |- ! {{ill|Fourth Green Wood Star|ja|四緑木星}} | Shiroku Mokusei | Wood | Southeast | {{ill|Xun|ja|巽}} | style="background:green;color:white;"| Green |- ! {{ill|Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} | Goō Dosei | Earth | Center | {{ill|Tai Chi|ja|太極}} | style="background:yellow;"| Yellow |- ! {{ill|Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}} | Roppaku Kinsei | Metal | Northwest | {{ill|Qian|ja|乾}} | style="background:white;"| White |- ! {{ill|Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星}} | Shichiseki Kinsei | Metal | {{ill|West|ja|西}} | {{ill|Dui|ja|兌}} | style="background:red;color:white;"| Red |- ! {{ill|Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} | Happaku Dosei | Earth | Northeast | {{ill|Gen|ja|艮}} | style="background:white;"| White |- ! {{ill|Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星}} | Kyūshi Kasei | Fire | {{ill|South|ja|南}} | {{ill|Li|ja|離}} | style="background:purple;color:white;"| Purple |}
Despite their names, the Nine Stars are not related to celestial objects like the planets in the {{ill|Solar System|ja|太陽系}}.
== Relationships Among the Stars == The relationships among the Nine Stars follow the {{ill|five elements theory|ja|五行思想}}:

Second Black Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | First White Water Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star |- ! Seventh Red Metal Star | First White Water Star, Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star |- ! Eighth White Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | First White Water Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star |- ! Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | Ninth Purple Fire Star | First White Water Star, Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star |}
These relationships are used for predicting {{ill|compatibility|ja|相性}}, {{ill|fortune|ja|運勢}}, and {{ill|auspicious directions|ja|吉方位}}.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei
== Years in Which Kyūshi Kasei Occupies the Center == Years in which the remainder when divided by 9 is 2 are Kyūshi Kasei years.

'''九紫火星'''（きゅうしかせい）とは、[[暦]]、[[占い]]に用いられる[[九星]]の一つ。後天定位盤において南に位置する。
九星で、五行の火に属する唯一の星である。
日の九星においては、原則として夏至に最も近い甲子の日を九紫として陽遁から陰遁に切り替わる。その際前の陽遁最終日と合わせて九紫が2日続く。
==属性== *[[五行思想|五行]] - 火 *[[八卦]] - 離 *[[十干]] - 丙、丁 *[[十二支]] - 午 *季節 - 夏 *方位 - 南 *月 - [[6月]] *時間 - 11時～13時 *数 - 二、七 *色 - 赤色 *味 - 苦味
==象意== *離合、神、高貴、華やかな美人、気の強い中年女性、結婚式、離婚、紫煙、印影、火事、高血圧、心臓疾患、脳病、見栄、虚飾、対立作用 *文書、火、学者、熱、光、明かり、栄光、苦味、精神、脱退、切断、破壊、発覚、目の病気、頭脳、視力、血球、顔面、頭部
==他の星との関係（相性）== *相生 - [[二黒土星]]（火生土）、[[三碧木星]]（木生火）、[[四緑木星]]（木生火）、[[五黄土星]]（火生土）、[[八白土星]]（火生土） *相克 - [[一白水星]]（水剋火）、[[六白金星]]（火剋金）、[[七赤金星]]（火剋金） *比和 - 九紫火星
==九紫火星の（中宮になる）年== 西暦年を9で割って2余る年が九紫火星の年となる。
‥‥ - [[1928年]] - [[1937年]] - [[1946年]] - [[1955年]] - [[1964年]] - [[1973年]] - [[1982年]] - [[1991年]] - [[2000年]] - [[2009年]] - [[2018年]] - [[2027年]] - [[2036年]] - [[2045年]] - [[2054年]] - [[2063年]] - [[2072年]] - ‥‥

==象意== *離合、神、高貴、華やかな美人、気の強い中年女性、結婚式、離婚、紫煙、印影、火事、高血圧、心臓疾患、脳病、見栄、虚飾、対立作用 *文書、火、学者、熱、光、明かり、栄光、苦味、精神、脱退、切断、破壊、発覚、目の病気、頭脳、視力、血球、顔面、頭部
==他の星との関係（相性）== *相生 - [[二黒土星]]（火生土）、[[三碧木星]]（木生火）、[[四緑木星]]（木生火）、[[五黄土星]]（火生土）、[[八白土星]]（火生土） *相克 - [[一白水星]]（水剋火）、[[六白金星]]（火剋金）、[[七赤金星]]（火剋金） *比和 - 九紫火星
==九紫火星の（中宮になる）年== 西暦年を9で割って2余る年が九紫火星の年となる。
‥‥ - [[1928年]] - [[1937年]] - [[1946年]] - [[1955年]] - [[1964年]] - [[1973年]] - [[1982年]] - [[1991年]] - [[2000年]] - [[2009年]] - [[2018年]] - [[2027年]] - [[2036年]] - [[2045年]] - [[2054年]] - [[2063年]] - [[2072年]] - ‥‥

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square |- | 4 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 7 |- | 8 || 1 || 6 |}
{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Kyūshi Kasei

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|calendars|ja|暦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/calendars|qq=}} and {{ill|fortune-telling|ja|占い|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fortune-telling|qq=}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|summer solstice|ja|夏至|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/summer solstice|qq=}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|2=ja|3=五行思想|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qq=}} - Fire * {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bagua|qq=}} - Li (離) * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems|ja|十干|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heavenly Stems|qq=}} - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * {{ill|Earthly Branches|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches|ja|十二支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}} - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|ja|6月|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/June|qq=}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) -
