'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Water overcomes Fire), {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}} (Fire overcomes Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}} (Fire overcomes Metal) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - Fire * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - Li (離) * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - Bing (丙), Ding (丁) * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - Wu (午) * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Nikoku Dosei|ja|二黒土星|1=Second Black Earth Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nikoku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Second Black Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood generates Fire), {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth), {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}} (Fire generates Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - '''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
