'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - {{ill|Fire (wuxing)|uk|Вогонь (У-сін)|bcl|Kalayo (wuxing)|pt|Fogo (astrologia)|vi|Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|ar|النار (وو شينغ)|ja|User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|qq=|lt=Fire (火)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - {{ill|Lí (Bagua)|ja|離|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li (離)|qq=}} * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|zh|丙|gan|丙|hak|Piáng (thiên-kôn)|ja|Hinoe|simple|User:Immanuelle/Hinoe (丙)|vi|Bính|za|Bingj (diengan)|zh-classical|丙|zh-min-nan|Piáⁿ (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|丙|zh|丙|qq=}}, {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|zh|丁|gan|丁|hak|Tên (thiên-kôn)|ja|Hinoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Hinoto (丁)|vi|Đinh (Thiên can)|za|Ding (diengan)|zh-classical|丁|zh-min-nan|Teng (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|丁|zh|丁 (天干)|qq=}} * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - [[:en:Horse (zodiac)|Horse (午)]] * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - {{ill|Fire (wuxing)|uk|Вогонь (У-сін)|bcl|Kalayo (wuxing)|pt|Fogo (astrologia)|vi|Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|ar|النار (وو شينغ)|ja|User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - {{ill|Lí (Bagua)|ja|離|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li (離)|qq=}} * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|zh|丙|gan|丙|hak|Piáng (thiên-kôn)|ja|Hinoe|simple|User:Immanuelle/Hinoe (丙)|vi|Bính|za|Bingj (diengan)|zh-classical|丙|zh-min-nan|Piáⁿ (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|丙|zh|丙|qq=}}, {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|zh|丁|gan|丁|hak|Tên (thiên-kôn)|ja|Hinoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Hinoto (丁)|vi|Đinh (Thiên can)|za|Ding (diengan)|zh-classical|丁|zh-min-nan|Teng (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|丁|zh|丁 (天干)|qq=}} * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - [[:en:Horse (zodiac)|Horse (午)]] * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - [[:en:June|June]] * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]]. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]].
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the [[:en:Summer solstice|summer solstice]] that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.
== Attributes == * {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}} - {{ill|Fire (wuxing)|uk|Вогонь (У-сін)|bcl|Kalayo (wuxing)|pt|Fogo (astrologia)|vi|Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|ar|النار (وو شينغ)|ja|User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} * {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}} - {{ill|Lí (Bagua)|ja|離|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li (離)|qq=}} * {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|WD=Q1190985|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems}} - {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|zh|丙|gan|丙|hak|Piáng (thiên-kôn)|ja|Hinoe|simple|User:Immanuelle/Hinoe (丙)|vi|Bính|za|Bingj (diengan)|zh-classical|丙|zh-min-nan|Piáⁿ (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|丙|zh|丙|qq=}}, {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|zh|丁|gan|丁|hak|Tên (thiên-kôn)|ja|Hinoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Hinoto (丁)|vi|Đinh (Thiên can)|za|Ding (diengan)|zh-classical|丁|zh-min-nan|Teng (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|丁|zh|丁 (天干)|qq=}} * {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches}} - {{ill|Horse (zodiac)|en|Horse (zodiac)|WD=Q869595|lt=Horse (午)}} * Season - Summer * Direction - South * Month - {{ill|June|en|June|WD=Q120|lt=June}} * Time - 11:00–13:00 * Number - Two, Seven * Color - Red * Taste - Bitter
== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Kyūshi is in the center |- | 8 || 4 || 6 |- | 7 || style="background-color:#FF80C0" | 9 || 2 |- | 3 || 5 || 1 |}
'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice|1=Summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice|1=Summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice|1=Summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice|1=Summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice|1=Summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

'''Kyūshi Kasei''' (九紫火星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}. In the Post-Heaven Lo Shu Square, it occupies the southern position.
Among the Nine Stars, it is the only one associated with the Fire element in the {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.
In the daily cycle of the Nine Stars, the day closest to the {{ill|Summer solstice|en|Summer solstice|WD=Q7603898|lt=summer solstice|1=Summer solstice}} that falls on a Kanoto (甲子) day is designated as Kyūshi, marking the transition from Yang to Yin. At that time, the last day of the previous Yang cycle and the first day of the new Yin cycle both belong to Kyūshi, making it appear for two consecutive days.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Separation and reunion, divinity, nobility, glamorous beauty, strong-willed middle-aged women, weddings, divorces, purple smoke, shadows, fires, high blood pressure, heart disease, brain disorders, vanity, embellishment, conflict * Documents, fire, scholars, heat, light, brilliance, glory, bitterness, spirit, withdrawal, severance, destruction, revelation, eye diseases, intellect, vision, blood cells, face, head
